$comment: TriMet Transit District boundary -- the polygon TriMet's own transit payroll excise tax (certificate.locality = 'TriMet', stateUnemploymentEmployerTax/oregonTransitTax in src/taxes/state.ts) applies inside. Not a Census geography and not covered by any live ArcGIS query service this project could find (checked: Metro RLIS carries City Limits/County/Metro Boundary/UGB layers but no transit-district layer; PortlandMaps publishes transit ROUTES and STOPS, not the district boundary) -- so unlike Portland Metro's SHS district and Ohio's JEDDs (both resolved live in geocode/districts.ts), this is vendored: fetched once from TriMet's own developer GIS portal and checked locally with a point-in-polygon test (geocode/districts.ts, isInsideTriMetDistrict()). A REFRESH COMMITMENT, not a live lookup -- TriMet's district boundary changes rarely (state law ties it to UGB-adjacent annexation, not an annual process) but this file should be re-fetched and diffed periodically against the same source URL, not assumed permanent.

source.title: TriMet District Boundary (official GIS download, developer.trimet.org)
source.format: KML, single Polygon, single outer ring, no holes -- confirmed by inspecting the raw file directly (1 Placemark, 1 Polygon, 1 outerBoundaryIs, 0 innerBoundaryIs) before conversion
source.projection: Downloaded coordinates are already WGS84 lon/lat (KML's standard), matching what census.ts's geocodeAddress() and the ArcGIS point-in-polygon queries elsewhere in this project already use -- no reprojection needed.

confidence: primary_source_confirmed -- fetched directly from TriMet's own official developer GIS portal, the same one TriMet's own tax-info page links to for boundary verification.
